name: mirage
text:
v1.0.115 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.115
What it does: the GitHub engine now reads your Vigilant wallet's whole Novig ledger (fills, fees, settlements, transfers) into a permanent file on GitHub, and the app's wallet and all-time profit figures read from that file. What it does not do yet: the per-bet Tracker list, daily P/L and charts are still built the old way, and the old Tracker data is not erased. Next I move those onto the ledger file and then erase the old data.
